title: SNC116 Therapy for Refractory Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
off: An Exploratory Clinical Study Evaluating the Safety, Preliminary Efficacy, and Pharmacokinetic Characteristics of SNC116 in the Treatment of Refractory Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
sponsor: The Affiliated Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School
summary: This study aims to evaluate the safety and tolerability of SNC116 in treating patients with systemic lupus erythematosus.

arms.d: Subjects diagnosed with Refractory Systemic Lupus Erythematosus

primary.m: Safety Evaluation: Incidence, characteristic and severity of all adverse events
